title: A problem with the rent
instructions: Kiracı Ece ev sahibiyle kira artışını konuşuyor. Uzun bir diyalog; rakamları ve uzlaşmayı takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Hello, Ece. I wanted to talk to you about the rent. From next month, it will go up to seven hundred pounds.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Seven hundred? It's six hundred now. That's a lot more.

script.speaker: a
script.text: I know, but my costs have gone up too, and other flats in this area are seven fifty.

script.speaker: b
script.text: I understand, but I can't pay a hundred pounds more. I've lived here for four years and always paid on time.

script.speaker: a
script.text: That's true. You're a very good tenant.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Could we say six hundred and fifty?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Hmm. OK, six fifty, but you sign a contract for two more years.

script.speaker: b
script.text: That's fine. And could you fix the kitchen window? It's been broken since the winter.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Yes, I'll send someone next week.

questions.prompt: How much is the rent now?
questions.feedback: Şu anki kira altı yüz pound.

questions.prompt: How much are other flats in the area?
questions.feedback: Bölgedeki diğer daireler yedi yüz elli.
questions.evidence: other flats in this area are seven fifty.

questions.prompt: How long has Ece lived in the flat?
questions.evidence: I've lived here for four years

questions.prompt: What rent do they agree on?
questions.feedback: Altı yüz elli pound, iki yıllık sözleşmeyle.

questions.prompt: What else will the landlord do?
questions.evidence: could you fix the kitchen window?
